name: RDK X5
summary: RDK X5 is a single-board development platform for robotics and edge AI. It combines an Arm Cortex-A55 CPU with a dedicated BPU and supports camera, network and control connections through MIPI CSI, USB, Gigabit Ethernet, CAN FD and general-purpose I/O. D-Robotics offers different memory configurations and provides Ubuntu support, model-deployment tools and TogetheROS.Bot middleware to help developers build and evaluate robot prototypes. The board serves as the onboard computing and integration platform for sensing, AI inference and robot application development.
